recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future build reports a new CommunicationRequest ordering warning, handle it as a current-source issue against structuredefinition-CommunicationRequest.xml and examples rather than unfinished FHIR-12682 work.
issue_request: FHIR-12682 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care issue for DSTU2 CommunicationRequest. It reported a QA warning that elements were out of order and requested the CommunicationRequest element/example order be corrected.
initial_application: Git commit 047a0c6ab1c00e633177a675d7146fc48793bf00 on 2017-01-24 explicitly named #12682 and moved CommunicationRequest spreadsheet rows and the financial-management example into the then-current order. The old spreadsheet text helper was removed in 2018 and the spreadsheet XML source was replaced by the current StructureDefinition XML source in 2021.
additional_context: CommunicationRequest remains active in source/fhir.ini, but current build authority is source/communicationrequest/structuredefinition-CommunicationRequest.xml. Later model changes added and renamed several elements, so the exact DSTU2 order from the Jira issue is obsolete. Current source order and CommunicationRequest examples were checked and are internally consistent; Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting related record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reapplying the original DSTU2 ordering would be incorrect for the current CommunicationRequest model, and the active source does not retain the historical out-of-order condition.
